name: @w6w-apps/millionverifier
description: Verify email addresses in real time, verify whole lists in bulk and check your credits with MillionVerifier.

w6w.longDescription:
MillionVerifier is an email verification service: it checks whether an address will actually be delivered before you send to it, so bad addresses never reach a list or a campaign.

A workflow can verify one address in real time (result and result code, quality, the detailed subresult, free-provider and role-account flags, a did-you-mean correction and the credits left), or upload a list for bulk verification, poll the file until it is finished, download the results filtered to the statuses you want, stop a file that is still running and delete it afterwards. The account's remaining and renewing credits are readable for free.

The connection holds a MillionVerifier API key (app.millionverifier.com/api). The vendor sends it as a query parameter, which the connection adds to each request for you; the single API (api.millionverifier.com) and the bulk API (bulkapi.millionverifier.com) name that parameter differently and both are handled. Verification and bulk files spend credits; the vendor's test key API_KEY_FOR_TEST returns random results at no cost.
